video_title: “I Took Those Ravens Teams for Granted” — Terrell Suggs Opens up on Ray, Ed Reed & BATTLING Brady

quotes.speaker: Terrell Suggs
quotes.summary_phrase: Terrell Suggs on the cultural impact of the Ravens' Black stars
quotes.excerpt: All our stars are black. Everybody had they teams growing up, but we wasn't playing your team
quotes.quote: All our stars are black. Everybody had they teams growing up, but we wasn't playing your team, you were cheering for the Ravens because we were the Black team.

quotes.speaker: Terrell Suggs
quotes.summary_phrase: Rex Ryan's simple, aggressive defensive philosophy for the Ravens
quotes.excerpt: Rex Ryan I'll never forget. He was like, you got one thing to do every time you line up
quotes.quote: Rex Ryan I'll never forget. He was like, you got one thing to do every time you line up: kick the guy's ass in front of you. Don't worry about the ball, don't worry about the play, don't worry about your assignment, whip the guy's ass in front of you.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the influence of his high school coach, Andre Boutte
quotes.excerpt: My high school coach, Andre Boutte. My mom died when I was five, my dad bounced on me
quotes.quote: My high school coach, Andre Boutte. My mom died when I was five, my dad bounced on me, and he was that father figure outside of my grandfather that pushed me.

quotes.speaker: Terrell Suggs
quotes.summary_phrase: Terrell Suggs on the influence of his cousin, Demar, on his career
quotes.excerpt: Besides my dad, I would have to say it was my older cousin Demar. He was the best
quotes.quote: Besides my dad, I would have to say it was my older cousin Demar. He was the best basketball player in the family until of course my cousin Jaylen came. But for a long time, my cousin Demar had the title and he was smarter than everybody. He was the quarterback in football and he was a shooting guard in basketball and he dominated our whole family.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his connection to Marcus Spears through AAU basketball
quotes.excerpt: My connection was Marcus Spears, because Swagu played for the Houston Hoops. People don't know but Swagu
quotes.quote: My connection was Marcus Spears, because Swagu played for the Houston Hoops. People don't know but Swagu played for the Houston Hoops. I was two years younger than Swagu and we all went to the same tournament. Man, when you talk about face up, jab, 15-footer, he never dunked with two hands. He always used to big palm the ball.

quotes.speaker: Terrell Suggs
quotes.summary_phrase: Terrell Suggs on the ownership and coaching history of the Houston Hoops
quotes.excerpt: The owner of the Houston Hoops is Hal Pastner. Hal Pastner's son is Josh Pastner
quotes.quote: The owner of the Houston Hoops is Hal Pastner. Hal Pastner's son is Josh Pastner who is the head coach at UNLV. So they've been tied, their relationship with Nike been running back 20 plus years. That's how deep they run. So that's the connection.

quotes.speaker: Terrell Suggs
quotes.summary_phrase: Terrell Suggs on the family rivalries and competitive nature of his upbringing
quotes.excerpt: It started with my Uncle Ricky. They call him Ricky Sweetwater Suggs. Once he started having a few
quotes.quote: It started with my Uncle Ricky. They call him Ricky Sweetwater Suggs. Once he started having a few beers, it's like I don't like the way my nephews are feeling their self. We can go out back. Next thing you know, it's heated.

quotes.speaker: Terrell Suggs
quotes.summary_phrase: Terrell Suggs on the Ravens' reputation as the 'Black team' in the NFL
quotes.excerpt: To the Black community, bro, y'all was everything to us dawg. If you even a fan of another
quotes.quote: To the Black community, bro, y'all was everything to us dawg. If you even a fan of another team, we wasn't playing your team, you cheer for us because all our stars are Black.

quotes.speaker: Terrell Suggs
quotes.summary_phrase: Terrell Suggs on the Ravens' draft strategy and the impact of Ozzie Newsome
quotes.excerpt: If you think about the genesis of the team, if you think about the guys who did all
quotes.quote: If you think about the genesis of the team, if you think about the guys who did all the drafting from the jump, Ozzie Newsome, his first time getting the job, he drafts Jonathan Ogden and Ray Lewis. Arguably the best tackle ever to play the game and hands down the best middle linebacker ever to play the game. That's why I told them that Baltimore is like the Black team, the quote-unquote Black team. And you know everybody had their teams growing up, but we wasn't playing your team, you were cheering for the Ravens because we were the Black team.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on Terrell Suggs' high school football background as a running back
quotes.excerpt: I think people forget Terrell in high school was a running back. So if you could imagine that
quotes.quote: I think people forget Terrell in high school was a running back. So if you could imagine that vision.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the physicality of Terrell Suggs' playstyle
quotes.excerpt: I remember, as best as I can remember, they gave the ball to Terrell like on a simple
quotes.quote: I remember, as best as I can remember, they gave the ball to Terrell like on a simple eye. It seemed little. Like, you knew he was getting the ball and whoever was in front of him was just going to get mowed over. And I remember, I think I remember him literally stiff-arming a dude's helmet to the side of his head and then mushing him to the ground like an anime character.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on Terrell Suggs' intense focus on prayer and music
quotes.excerpt: He wouldn't listen to the music, he would just listen to the prayers and put them on repeat
quotes.quote: He wouldn't listen to the music, he would just listen to the prayers and put them on repeat. He had that big old book, he had like a one of these of just CDs and he'd be like, 'Yo, Channing.' And I said, 'I already know where you're going. You heard that new DMX?' I go, 'Yeah.' Dog, I don't want to hear the prayers again, man. I got enough Jesus.
